Private Taxi & Chauffeur Service in Jeddah

Pre-booked private cars for international visitors, Umrah travellers, families, business travellers and companies — from JED arrivals to Makkah, Madinah, your hotel or a day around the city. One fare, agreed before you book.

The short answer

Taxi Saudi Arabia arranges pre-booked private transport in Jeddah through a vetted partner network: airport transfers from King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED, about 20 km from the centre), Jeddah–Makkah (80 km from JED) and Jeddah–Madinah (420 km) transfers, hotel transfers, private drivers by the hour, and intercity cars. We track your flight, waiting is free for 15–30 minutes, and the fare is agreed on WhatsApp before you book.

JED airport transfer

Your JED airport transfer, step by step

JED has Terminal 1, the North Terminal and a Hajj Terminal. Central Jeddah is about 20 km away; Makkah about 80 km.

Haramain train or a private car to Makkah?

The train leaves from a station connected to JED Terminal 1. Both are good options — they suit different travellers.

Comparison of the Haramain train and a private car from Jeddah Airport to Makkah
  Private car Haramain train
Door to doorCar:Yes — terminal or hotel to hotelTrain:Station to station; a transfer is needed at each end
LuggageCar:All bags in one vehicle, loaded by the driverTrain:Carried through two stations
Family or groupCar:One fare for the whole carTrain:A ticket per person
Time in motionCar:About ~1 hr JED → MakkahTrain:About 45 min airport station → Makkah station
TimetableCar:Leave when you are ready, 24/7Train:Fixed departures

Plan your timing

What changes journey times in Jeddah

Drive times shift with the season, the hour and the day of the week. These are the things that move them.

01

Night arrivals at JED

Many international flights land late at night or before dawn. Transfers run 24/7 — book ahead so the car is waiting rather than searched for at 3 am.

02

Umrah peaks and Ramadan

Jeddah–Makkah traffic and airport crowds build sharply in Ramadan and peak Umrah weeks. Leave extra time for departures, and book vans and SUVs early in those weeks.

03

Corniche evenings

The waterfront is busiest on Thursday and Friday evenings. A fixed pickup time and point saves circling the promenade.

04

Old town access

Cars cannot drive through the historic core of Al-Balad. Drop-off and pickup happen at its edge — agree the exact point in advance.

05

Summer heat

From late spring to autumn, plan outdoor sightseeing for early morning and after sunset, with the car close by between stops.

06

Long drives

Madinah is about ~4 hr of driving and Taif climbs a steep escarpment road. Tell the driver your preferred prayer and rest stops at the start.

First time in Jeddah?

What international visitors usually ask

How do I get from Jeddah airport to Makkah?

The simplest way is a pre-booked private car from your JED terminal to your Makkah hotel — about 80 km and ~1 hr, with your bags in the same vehicle. The Haramain train from the Terminal 1 station is the alternative if you travel light and are happy to transfer at Makkah station.

Which terminal will I arrive at?

JED has Terminal 1, the North Terminal and, in pilgrimage season, the Hajj Terminal. Your airline confirms which; send us the flight number and we plan the pickup for that terminal.

Can I go straight from the airport to Madinah?

Yes. JED Airport to Madinah is about 410 km by road. Many families do this on arrival day rather than stopping in Jeddah — tell us if you want a meal or prayer stop on the way.

What should I book for a day in Jeddah?

If you have three or more stops — Al-Balad, the Corniche, a mall, a restaurant — book a car by the hour. For a single trip, book a one-way transfer and a timed return.

Can I travel with a lot of luggage?

Yes. Tell us the number of large cases when you book. Full-size SUVs, vans and coasters are the usual choice for Umrah families with luggage and zamzam.

How do I pay?

Cash to the driver or bank transfer. An electronic receipt is available on request.

FAQ

Jeddah transport questions, answered

Short answers to what travellers ask before booking.

Ask on WhatsApp

How far is Jeddah airport from the city centre?

King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED) is about 20 km from central Jeddah — ~30 min on a clear road. Hotels in the far north (Obhur) are closer; Al-Balad in the south is further.

Do you track my flight if it is delayed?

Yes. Share your flight number when you book and we track the flight, so a delay moves your pickup. 15–30 minutes of waiting after landing is free.

What is the best way to get from Jeddah Airport to Makkah?

For most visitors, a pre-booked private car: about 80 km and ~1 hr from your terminal to your Makkah hotel, with all your luggage in one vehicle. The Haramain train is faster in motion but runs station to station, so you still need a car at the Makkah end.

How long is the drive from Jeddah to Madinah?

About 420 km — ~4 hr of driving, longer with the prayer and rest stops you ask for. From JED airport it is about 410 km.

Can the driver take us to our Makkah hotel door?

The driver takes you as close to your hotel as vehicles are permitted. Near the Haram some roads close at peak times, and the driver uses the nearest allowed drop-off point.

Can I hire a car with driver in Jeddah for a day?

Yes. Book a private driver by the hour or for a full day; the car waits between stops. It suits sightseeing across Al-Balad and the Corniche, a day of meetings, or a long shopping day.

How much does a private transfer in Jeddah cost?

The fare depends on the route, vehicle, date and any waiting time. It is quoted per trip and agreed before booking — one fixed price, no meter, no surge.

What vehicle should a family with luggage book?

A full-size SUV takes up to seven passengers with several large cases; a VIP van or a coaster suits larger families and groups. A sedan fits one to three people with normal luggage.

Can I cancel or change a booking?

Yes. Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before pickup, and changes to time or address can be made on WhatsApp.

Can my company be invoiced?

Yes. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company. Email your company details and trip list for a written quote before booking.

Do the drivers speak English?

Yes. Drivers in our Jeddah partner network speak English and Arabic, and trips run 24 hours a day.
